name: sol_token_nfe1_3
description: Reentrancy via ERC721/1155 safeTransferFrom callback to external receiver contracts
question: The source file in `source` defines a function that calls safeTransferFrom (or _safeMint/_mint with a receiver hook) on an ERC721 or ERC1155 token to an external/user-supplied address, performs additional state changes (e.g., updating balances, minting counters, marking a sale/claim as complete, or making further transfers) after that call, and does not use a reentrancy guard or the checks-effects-interactions pattern, allowing the receiver's onERC721Received/onERC1155Received callback to reenter and exploit the stale state. This excludes cases where all state is updated before the transfer call, a nonReentrant modifier or equivalent lock is applied, or the transfer target is guaranteed to be a trusted/non-contract address.
criteria: A withdraw or claim function calls safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, tokenId) to send an NFT before setting a claimed[msg.sender] or balance mapping to false/zero, with no reentrancy guard
A mint function calls _safeMint(to, tokenId) triggering onERC721Received before incrementing totalSupply or updating a per-user mint counter used for a mint limit check
A batch transfer function calls safeBatchTransferFrom for ERC1155 tokens before deducting the corresponding amounts from an internal balances or escrow mapping
A sale/auction settlement function calls safeTransferFrom to deliver the NFT to the buyer before updating the listing's sold/active status or refunding excess payment
A staking or vault contract calls safeTransferFrom to return a staked NFT to the owner before clearing the stake record or resetting reward accrual state
